events.title: AI compute expansion signals sharper localized demand on urban transmission corridors
events.summary: Concentrated AI-driven data-center growth may create localized transmission stress. Monitor interconnection queue patterns and transformer lead-time trends.

events.title: Critical-minerals procurement signals could tighten high-voltage transformer timelines
events.summary: Material procurement constraints may extend lead times for high-voltage equipment. Contractors should assess secondary sourcing and refurbishment options.

events.title: SF6 alternative adoption signals mixed timelines for GIS and breakers
events.summary: Transition away from SF6 shows promise but may cause short-term integration and certification delays for GIS and breakers.

events.title: Modular substation solutions gain traction as a hedge against long lead times
events.summary: Modular substations could mitigate schedule risk from long custom-equipment lead times, but require integration planning.

events.title: On-site renewables and microgrid adoption may reduce grid peak exposure for hyperscale regions
events.summary: On-site renewables plus storage at data centers can reduce peak grid stress but require new interconnection and coordination practices.

events.title: Distributed PV intermittency signals new constraints on low-voltage distribution protection
events.summary: High distributed PV can degrade traditional protection schemes and require updated inverter coordination and hosting limits.

events.title: Policy signals in mining jurisdictions could reshape cobalt supply chain timing
events.summary: Mining policy shifts in producing countries may slow near-term processed cobalt availability while incentivizing local refining capacity development.

events.title: Capacity-market valuation shifts could change storage project economics
events.summary: Potential capacity-market design changes could improve storage economics but create near-term financing uncertainty.

events.title: Predictive-maintenance AI adoption may lower transformer failure signals
events.summary: AI-enabled predictive maintenance could reduce some transformer failure modes but depends on sensorization and data practices.

events.title: Domestic smelting incentive signals may increase local copper cathode availability over medium term
events.summary: Onshore refining incentives could boost local copper cathode availability over months to years, relieving some supply-chain pressure.
